verdict.rationale: ChatGPT ships a dedicated Browser feature that opens websites, gathers current information, and takes action while the user stays in control, explicitly for comparing options and completing multi-step tasks on websites, plus Computer Use for operating GUIs and Site tools/WebMCP for invoking in-page actions. This is well-documented first-party functionality directly matching the story, though independent hands-on validation of the browsing/agentic-action capability specifically (vs. other features) is thin. Missing for 10: independent/community corroboration of real-world browser-agent task completion, and detail on reliability/limits of autonomous web actions.
